messages.text: Solar

Solar's the best answer to that question — the sats it stacks are basically all yours, and the block shot runs 24/7 either way. The H15 Dual is $999, mining BTC and Doge.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
Ontario
Ran the power-cost calculator · 2¢/kWh
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin miner

Good setup for it. The H15 pulls ~500 W, so about 360 kWh a month — on solar that's power you're already making, which is the best case for a home miner.

You get 15 TH/s of Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s on Doge, ~50 dB, and it ships November 14, 2026.

Where would it sit — office or garage?
is there a promo code- its too much money
Handed to the team · Discount request — pricing decisions are Georges'.

I don't have a code to give — the listed price is the price. I've passed it to Georges; he'll jump into this chat, or email you if you step away.

If $999 is the sticking point, the Thor P2 is $369 for 10 TH/s and the BC04 $239 for 6 TH/s — both Bitcoin only, no Doge side. Want numbers on either?
this would go great with my 2 magic miner 40T setups

It would — your 40Ts are SHA-256 only, so the H15 adds a whole second algorithm on the Doge/Litecoin side plus 15 TH/s of Bitcoin on the newer BM1373 chips.

On solar, running three is mostly just amps, not dollars. Want me to build the H15 cart?
I'll wait until there is a miner like this size that does 2.16GH/s doge only
Used the chat-interview skill

Fair. Nothing we sell comes close to that on scrypt — the biggest is the Hammer DC08 at 480 MH/s for $539. I won't promise a unit that doesn't exist yet.

Before you go, one thing: what's driving the Doge-only push over a dual like the H15?
if it was $899 I would buy one

The H15 is $999 and I can't move it — Georges already has your note, so if there's any room he'll say so right here.

What I can do: the B30 is $899 today, 30 TH/s of Bitcoin on the same BM1373 chips, Bitcoin only. Want the numbers on that one?
NO thank you as I already have 2 magic mier 40T each
Understood — you've got the SHA-256 side covered. Georges has your note on the H15 price and will come back to you here, or by email if you've stepped away.
he has me on discord in private chat
Good — then reach him there too. The note's in his queue either way, so he'll have the context on the H15 when you talk.

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual numbers for where you live.
